text: This report is in response to City Council’s direction on January 30, 2019 that the Deputy City Manager, Community and Social Services report on options for an aggressive supportive and transitional housing build plan in Toronto. On February 15, 2019, the Affordable Housing Office (AHO) and Shelter, Support and Housing Administration (SSHA) hosted an initial meeting of supportive and transitional housing providers to discuss challenges and opportunities in the sector. A cross-section of 19 agencies from the supportive and transitional housing sector participated in the meeting representing a range of clients and needs. The initial discussion resulted in a number of concrete suggestions on addressing the urgent need for supportive housing for homeless and vulnerable residents.
